subject: general
question: Four letter clusters have given out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different, Select the odd one
solution:
[IMAGE: https://lh6.googleusercontent.com/3tuELsedTf7tmpX1myNfd4kOCqi8E_SmumrFAjlMpa9Q57qja9YILr3ppcjA3UGCK8u3I-jp5Ww1p_07Fk3HgOu18JL_2d4odA368OnvUMlfaaMMBmxnn8sknIwe3Tf4E849C-SZ=s0] 

From option 1:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7d7839a0cbae412efd32e68d4eb013c96a9096671e2ca5a9aeece105d848ebad.png] 

We add three in first letter we get second letter, we subtract one in second letter we get third letter and again we subtract one in third letter we get fourth letter.

From option 2:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/18eb5da5bc6c2726c2f7a421fa26644b59673d10fc6d6ace6a356c89c014109c.png] 

We add three in first letter we get second letter, we subtract one in second letter we get third letter and again we subtract one in third letter we get fourth letter.

**From option 3:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a52b0c2060471184482a01da9bf7900db4cfb80703d0519d9af2d3ad40996a26.png] 

We add four in first letter we get second letter, we subtract two in second letter we get third letter and we add one in third letter we get fourth letter.

This is different from others.

From option 4:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b1781d98080a656dd3b6cb9717c4df393874e68c44bcac6ebac98c97cf668499.png] 

We add three in first letter we get second letter, we subtract one in second letter we get third letter and again we subtract one in third letter we get fourth letter.

Hence, **"option 3"** is the correct answer.
